page.overview:
Who is Drew Dieghan?

Captain Drew Dieghan or Drew Deighan was a Starfleet commanding officer in the 24th century.

In 2346, he was the commander of the . His ship was the first to respond to Klingon distress signals when the Khitomer outpost was destroyed. ()
